content.subject: Sandbox fulfillment testing at ShipBob
content.draft_text:
Hi Test,

ShipBob’s new Simulation Terminal lets you run a full fulfillment lifecycle in a sandbox, keeping real inventory untouched.
The sandbox mirrors every pick, pack, and ship event.

When fulfillment steps can be rehearsed, teams avoid the manual reconciliation that follows trial runs.
That eliminates the guesswork before a live rollout.

We feed sandbox results into automated reconciliation scripts that update your operational dashboards.
Errors surface before they affect customers.

Is the time spent on manual reconciliation acceptable for your team?

Zamp
